posts.cooked:
Every One:

Why is he compromising his acc for this?

There are varying reasons why people does Scripting or use Bot programs, most commonly RMT. If enough time passes between getting caught, any revenue they gained out ways the annoyance of having to setup it all over on new account.

CCP can do little to effectively prevent such people to just make new accounts:

  1. IP bans does little - VPNs exist and IPs can be changed.
  2. Hardware Ban does little - Hardware can be changed to change the PC’s hardware profile/id.
  3. Banning a player by Personal Information is much more effective but still not full proof, fake/stolen IDs exist.

Vuhdo Rin:

sorry, but i dont trust anyone who say anybody is a botter ! you cant prove it, and the only thing you can do is report them

A long long time ago, I used to hunt bots in highsec. Back then, I’ve had a thread that listed several dozens of them with detailed descriptions of their behavioral patterns, which I then used to both hunt them in the game and report them to CCP.

What I’ve learned from replies in my thread back then is that there are always people that say exactly what you’ve said. It turned out that most of them fall into one of two categories:

  • Those who use the scripts themselves and are thinking that they are adding doubt to other players so that their own bots aren’t targeted.
  • Forum trolls.

And yes, any player can detect bots. We are humans. We are wired to recognize patterns. If something is acting following an unusual (non-human) pattern, it’s a bot…. with 99% certainty. Gaslighting others that they can’t detect a bot simply does not work.
